title: Photoshop Pricing in 2026 and What Each Adobe Plan Costs
summary: Photoshop pricing spans five plans with three rate tiers—annual commitments cost less than month-to-month options. Compare them to find your best fit.
body_markdown:
## Hidden costs in Adobe's annual and monthly terms


On a shared login, none of Adobe's added costs lands on the client who caused it: an early cancellation fee, a monthly-billing premium, renewal changes, sales tax and $9.99-per-terabyte storage top-ups, leaving whoever manages the shared account to cover charges they didn't incur.


Each one needs its own line when you price a retainer.


### Early cancellation fee on annual-billed plans


**Cancel an annual plan billed monthly after the first 14 days and Adobe charges 50% of the remaining contract** , per[Adobe Community](https://community.adobe.com/questions-6/i-need-someone-to-explain-this-how-does-the-early-cancellation-fee-work-431179) , which means the grace window is your only exit path before the penalty takes effect.


**Cancelling in month 1 costs $291.50** , a real exit bill that is enough to deter some customers from leaving even when dissatisfied.


Month by month the fee drops by $26.50. The table below shows that decline, so a lost client in month 2 costs you far more than the same loss in month 6.


Month of cancellation Early cancellation fee


1 $291.50


2 $265


3 $238.50


4 $212


5 $185.50


6 $159


Even at month 6 you owe $159 for software nobody is using. Bill that exposure to the client who triggered the seat, not to the shared pool.


### Renewal price changes


A quote that was right in January is a guess by next January, because Adobe can change the price at renewal. Build a margin for it into the retainer instead of absorbing it.


Decline the annual commitment and the same plan costs more per month, which makes monthly billing the other premium. That premium buys flexibility, so charge it only to clients whose work is genuinely short-term.


On top of both comes sales tax, so a budget set from the pre-tax price is already short.


Storage works the same way: every extra terabyte at $9.99 is a recurring charge that follows whichever project filled it.


Pay for All Apps and you get every Creative Cloud program in one price. Audit each seat's real usage before renewal, and move Photoshop-only seats to a single-app plan.
